name: The Ginger Man
take: The long wood bar with sixty-odd taps that Murray Hill has been meeting at since the nineties. Beer people, after-work people, a back room that fills on game nights.
theCatch: It's a beer bar first; the cocktails are an afterthought. Weeknights after 6 the front bar is three deep with the office crowd.
notes: Starter entry for the neighborhood; check it's still open and verify in person. E 36th between Lex and 3rd. Sixty-plus taps, cask ales, a long list; pub food; back room with tables.

name: Middle Branch
take: A proper cocktail bar on a block that mostly does pitchers: two floors, low light, drinks made the careful way, and a piano some nights. The grown-up option in Murray Hill.
theCatch: Small, and it fills by 10 on weekends; come early or expect to stand upstairs. Not the place for a loud group of eight.
notes: Starter entry for the neighborhood; check it's still open and verify in person. E 33rd between Lex and 3rd, from the Little Branch / Milk & Honey family. Two floors; jazz some nights; classic cocktails.
